$comment: Declares the CURRENT publish batch for scripts/check-publish-scope.mjs (--plan). CI tags only trigger the run; the publish set comes from `targets`, and only tags listed in `tags` may trigger it. Clear `targets` (and `tags`) right after the batch is published — a stale plan makes every later release run fail on 'version already exists'. The counterpart for deliberately-deferred packages is release/holds.json.
